title: MEHF: ligand conformational ensembles by flow matching with stiffness-aware noise (code, checkpoints and result record)
description: Code, trained checkpoints and the complete pre-registered result record for T. Ding, D. Xiang and L. Dong, "Generating Ligand Conformational Ensembles by Flow Matching with Stiffness-Aware Noise" (submitted to IEEE Transactions on Computational Biology and Bioinformatics). Includes the original-protocol runs, the clean-protocol replication (cleanrun/) and the post-hoc analyses (paper_analysis/). Trajectory data derive from MISATO (doi:10.5281/zenodo.7711953, CC BY 4.0).
